text:
Riley: Started a 4% canary for v3-int4 on /generate focusing on concat-doc scenarios (very long concatenated context). Early checks show a factuality uplift negative on that cohort.
Noah: paste quick deltas pls.
Riley: small snapshot:
```
cohort: concat-docs (>=2500 tokens)
  baseline(v2-fp16): factuality_fail=2.9%, mrr=0.868, p99=230ms
  v3-int4:            factuality_fail=5.7% (+2.8pp), mrr=0.856 (-0.012), p99=242ms (+12ms)
other cohorts: negligible change
compute: ~-21% token-cpu
```
Mei: That +2.8pp crosses our 2.0pp canary gate. Are we using the same truth anchors?
Riley: yes same anchor set + auto QA. Also flagged many as "context-confabulation" in severity bucket.
Carlos: Any KV-cache signals? Quant kernels sometimes change cache eviction frequency when contexts interleave.
Riley: KV hit drop: baseline 88.6% -> v3-int4 82.0% (-6.6pp).
Noah: Ok that's consistent with more regeneration leading to hallucinations. Proposal: reduce traffic to 0.5%, pin concat-doc cohort to v2 baseline and run a seeded 150k concat-doc eval overnight.
Mei: +1. Also add a temporary routing rule: anything with concatenated doc flag -> route to baseline. Keep v3 int4 shadowing but no user traffic.
CanaryBot: Canary 1749991234 deployed: 4% -> pool "dedicated-alpha" (A100). Observability job "seeded-concat-eval" queued.
Carlos: If quant is suspect, spin an unquantized v3-fp16 build as sanity. If fp16 matches baseline, it's quant related.
Noah: Also add a composite fallback metric we discussed: "EntropyGuard" = weighted(max(halluc_delta/2pp, -factuality_delta/0.02, kv_hit_drop/4pp)). If EntropyGuard >= 1 -> immediate reroute. For this run EntropyGuard ~= max(2.8/2, 0.012/0.02, 6.6/4) = max(1.4,0.6,1.65)=1.65 (trips).
Mei: I'll flip the routing rule and schedule the seeded run. Riley, can you capture per-layer eviction heatmap? If layer-attention windows are evicting earlier we should see it.
Riley: on it. Action list: 1) throttle 4% -> 0.5% now; 2) pin concat-doc cohort to v2; 3) kick seeded 150k eval; 4) build v3-fp16; 5) collect per-layer kv eviction traces. Will share links when available.
CanaryBot: Canary traffic adjusted at 1749991242: 4% -> 0.5%. Routing rule applied: concat-doc cohort pinned to v2-fp16. Shadowing of v3-int4 continues.
Carlos: If quant-layer mix helps, try keeping attention/query/proj in int8+rest int4. Also try asymmetric quant for rotary embeddings.
Noah: Add MRR smoothing window 15m before gating to avoid flips.
Mei: good note. Riley: ping when traces are uploaded.
Riley: Will do
